quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ a small café on the corner of this street.
quests.completedSentence: There is a small café on the corner of this street.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.ruleExplanation: The subject here is 'a small café', which is singular. That's why 'there is' is correct.
quests.nativeTip: In 'there is/are' sentences, the real subject comes right after the verb - check its number.
quests.example: There is a small café on the corner of this street.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ a strong wind blowing today.
quests.completedSentence: There is a strong wind blowing today.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.ruleExplanation: 'A strong wind' is singular, so the sentence uses 'there is'.
quests.nativeTip: Even though 'there' starts the sentence, look ahead to find what's really being talked about.
quests.example: There is a strong wind blowing today.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ one empty seat left in the front row.
quests.completedSentence: There is one empty seat left in the front row.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.ruleExplanation: 'One empty seat' is singular, so the sentence uses 'there is'.
quests.nativeTip: Count how many seats are being described before choosing the verb.
quests.example: There is one empty seat left in the front row.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'are' when the subject that follows is plural
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ several new restaurants opening downtown this year.
quests.completedSentence: There are several new restaurants opening downtown this year.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'are' when the subject that follows is plural
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Several new restaurants' is plural, so the sentence uses 'there are'.
quests.nativeTip: Check the noun after the blank - is it one restaurant or several?
quests.example: There are several new restaurants opening downtown this year.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'are' when the subject that follows is plural
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ two ways to solve this problem.
quests.completedSentence: There are two ways to solve this problem.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'are' when the subject that follows is plural
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Two ways' is plural, so the sentence uses 'there are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Two ways' already signals more than one - match the verb to that.
quests.example: There are two ways to solve this problem.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'are' when the subject that follows is plural
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ many reasons to celebrate today.
quests.completedSentence: There are many reasons to celebrate today.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'are' when the subject that follows is plural
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Many reasons' is plural, so the sentence uses 'there are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Many reasons' is clearly more than one thing - choose the verb that matches.
quests.example: There are many reasons to celebrate today.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There is' + singular noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a plural noun
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ a box of old photographs in the attic.
quests.completedSentence: There is a box of old photographs in the attic.
quests.grammarRule: 'There is' + singular noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a plural noun
quests.ruleExplanation: The true subject is 'a box', which is singular; 'of old photographs' just describes what's inside it. The sentence uses 'there is'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Of old photographs' might look plural, but check what comes right after 'there'.
quests.example: There is a box of old photographs in the attic.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There is' + singular noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a plural noun
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ a group of tourists waiting outside the museum.
quests.completedSentence: There is a group of tourists waiting outside the museum.
quests.grammarRule: 'There is' + singular noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a plural noun
quests.ruleExplanation: The true subject is 'a group', which is singular. The sentence uses 'there is'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Of tourists' is plural, but that's not the noun deciding the verb here.
quests.example: There is a group of tourists waiting outside the museum.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There is' + singular noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a plural noun
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ a bowl of fresh strawberries on the counter.
quests.completedSentence: There is a bowl of fresh strawberries on the counter.
quests.grammarRule: 'There is' + singular noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a plural noun
quests.ruleExplanation: 'A bowl' is the true subject and is singular, so the sentence uses 'there is'.
quests.nativeTip: Focus on 'a bowl', not the plural fruit inside it.
quests.example: There is a bowl of fresh strawberries on the counter.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There are' + plural noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a singular noun
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ several photos of the old building online.
quests.completedSentence: There are several photos of the old building online.
quests.grammarRule: 'There are' + plural noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a singular noun
quests.ruleExplanation: The true subject is 'several photos', which is plural, even though 'of the old building' is singular. The sentence uses 'there are'.
quests.nativeTip: This time, the noun right after 'there' is already plural - check it carefully.
quests.example: There are several photos of the old building online.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There are' + plural noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a singular noun
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ many types of cheese in this shop.
quests.completedSentence: There are many types of cheese in this shop.
quests.grammarRule: 'There are' + plural noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a singular noun
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Many types' is plural, so the sentence uses 'there are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Many types' is the real subject here, not the single kind of food mentioned after 'of'.
quests.example: There are many types of cheese in this shop.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There are' + plural noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a singular noun
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ two versions of this song available.
quests.completedSentence: There are two versions of this song available.
quests.grammarRule: 'There are' + plural noun, even when followed by an 'of' phrase with a singular noun
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Two versions' is plural, so the sentence uses 'there are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Two versions' is plural, even though only one song is being discussed.
quests.example: There are two versions of this song available.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There isn't' / 'there aren't' agrees with the noun that follows, just like the positive form
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ any parking available near the stadium tonight.
quests.completedSentence: There isn't any parking available near the stadium tonight.
quests.grammarRule: 'There isn't' / 'there aren't' agrees with the noun that follows, just like the positive form
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Parking' is uncountable and singular here, so the negative form is 'isn't'.
quests.nativeTip: Even in the negative, check the noun that follows to choose 'isn't' or 'aren't'.
quests.example: There isn't any parking available near the stadium tonight.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There isn't' / 'there aren't' agrees with the noun that follows, just like the positive form
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ any tickets left for tonight's show.
quests.completedSentence: There aren't any tickets left for tonight's show.
quests.grammarRule: 'There isn't' / 'there aren't' agrees with the noun that follows, just like the positive form
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Tickets' is plural, so the negative form is 'aren't'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Tickets' is countable and plural - which negative form matches that?
quests.example: There aren't any tickets left for tonight's show.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There isn't' / 'there aren't' agrees with the noun that follows, just like the positive form
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ enough time to finish the project today.
quests.completedSentence: There isn't enough time to finish the project today.
quests.grammarRule: 'There isn't' / 'there aren't' agrees with the noun that follows, just like the positive form
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Time' is singular/uncountable here, so the negative form is 'isn't'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Time' is uncountable, just like 'parking' in the first question of this level.
quests.example: There isn't enough time to finish the project today.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Is there' / 'are there' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: ___ there a doctor available right now?
quests.completedSentence: Is there a doctor available right now?
quests.grammarRule: 'Is there' / 'are there' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'A doctor' is singular, so the question uses 'Is there...?'
quests.nativeTip: In questions, 'there' still moves to the front, but the subject after it decides the verb.
quests.example: Is there a doctor available right now?

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Is there' / 'are there' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: ___ there any seats left for the concert?
quests.completedSentence: Are there any seats left for the concert?
quests.grammarRule: 'Is there' / 'are there' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Any seats' is plural, so the question uses 'Are there...?'
quests.nativeTip: 'Seats' is countable and plural - match the question word to that.
quests.example: Are there any seats left for the concert?

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Is there' / 'are there' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: ___ there a reason for the delay?
quests.completedSentence: Is there a reason for the delay?
quests.grammarRule: 'Is there' / 'are there' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'A reason' is singular, so the question uses 'Is there...?'
quests.nativeTip: Check whether 'a reason' is one thing or several before choosing.
quests.example: Is there a reason for the delay?

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Here ___ the documents you requested.
quests.completedSentence: Here are the documents you requested.
quests.grammarRule: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'The documents' is plural, so the sentence uses 'here are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Here' works just like 'there' - the noun that follows decides the verb.
quests.example: Here are the documents you requested.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Here ___ your receipt for today's purchase.
quests.completedSentence: Here is your receipt for today's purchase.
quests.grammarRule: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Your receipt' is singular, so the sentence uses 'here is'.
quests.nativeTip: Check whether 'your receipt' is one item or several.
quests.example: Here is your receipt for today's purchase.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Here ___ a few tips for beginners.
quests.completedSentence: Here are a few tips for beginners.
quests.grammarRule: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'A few tips' is plural, so the sentence uses 'here are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'A few tips' already signals more than one - match the verb to that.
quests.example: Here are a few tips for beginners.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Down the street ___ an old stone church.
quests.completedSentence: Down the street stands an old stone church.
quests.grammarRule: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.ruleExplanation: The subject is 'an old stone church', which comes after the verb here. It's singular, so the verb takes -s: 'stands'.
quests.nativeTip: This sentence starts with a place, not the subject - find the subject after the verb.
quests.example: Down the street stands an old stone church.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Among the invited guests ___ several well-known authors.
quests.completedSentence: Among the invited guests are several well-known authors.
quests.grammarRule: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.ruleExplanation: The subject is 'several well-known authors', which is plural, even though it comes after the verb. The verb is 'are'.
quests.nativeTip: Look past the opening phrase about the guests to find who or what the sentence is really about.
quests.example: Among the invited guests are several well-known authors.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.sentenceWithBlank: At the top of the hill ___ a small lighthouse.
quests.completedSentence: At the top of the hill sits a small lighthouse.
quests.grammarRule: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.ruleExplanation: The subject is 'a small lighthouse', which is singular. The verb takes -s: 'sits'.
quests.nativeTip: The sentence opens with a location - the real subject is still waiting after the verb.
quests.example: At the top of the hill sits a small lighthouse.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Agreement follows the postposed subject, not the noun in the fronted phrase
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Inside the old wooden boxes ___ a single faded photograph.
quests.completedSentence: Inside the old wooden boxes lies a single faded photograph.
quests.grammarRule: Agreement follows the postposed subject, not the noun in the fronted phrase
quests.ruleExplanation: The true subject is 'a single faded photograph', which is singular, even though 'boxes' (plural) appears earlier in the sentence. The verb takes -s: 'lies'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Boxes' is plural, but it's part of the opening phrase, not the actual subject.
quests.example: Inside the old wooden boxes lies a single faded photograph.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Agreement follows the postposed subject, not the noun in the fronted phrase
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Beneath the pile of papers ___ several missing files.
quests.completedSentence: Beneath the pile of papers are several missing files.
quests.grammarRule: Agreement follows the postposed subject, not the noun in the fronted phrase
quests.ruleExplanation: The true subject is 'several missing files', which is plural, even though 'pile' (singular) appears in the opening phrase. The verb is 'are'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Pile' is singular, but check what actually comes after the verb.
quests.example: Beneath the pile of papers are several missing files.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Agreement follows the postposed subject, not the noun in the fronted phrase
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Next to the row of houses ___ a small community garden.
quests.completedSentence: Next to the row of houses sits a small community garden.
quests.grammarRule: Agreement follows the postposed subject, not the noun in the fronted phrase
quests.ruleExplanation: The true subject is 'a small community garden', which is singular. The verb takes -s: 'sits'.
quests.nativeTip: 'Houses' is plural, but that's not the subject of this sentence.
quests.example: Next to the row of houses sits a small community garden.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.sentenceWithBlank: There ___ a strange noise coming from the basement.
quests.completedSentence: There is a strange noise coming from the basement.
quests.grammarRule: 'There' + 'is' when the subject that follows is singular
quests.ruleExplanation: 'A strange noise' is singular, so the sentence uses 'there is'.
quests.nativeTip: Bring back the basic 'there is/are' rule: check the noun that follows.
quests.example: There is a strange noise coming from the basement.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Here ___ the results you've been waiting for.
quests.completedSentence: Here are the results you've been waiting for.
quests.grammarRule: 'Here is' / 'here are' agrees with the noun that follows
quests.ruleExplanation: 'The results' is plural, so the sentence uses 'here are'.
quests.nativeTip: Remember: 'here' works exactly like 'there' for agreement.
quests.example: Here are the results you've been waiting for.

quests.conceptTitle: Grammar Scale: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.sentenceWithBlank: Across the valley ___ a chain of snow-capped mountains.
quests.completedSentence: Across the valley stretches a chain of snow-capped mountains.
quests.grammarRule: Inverted sentence structure with the subject placed after the verb
quests.ruleExplanation: The subject is 'a chain', which is singular (even though it refers to many mountains), so the verb takes -s: 'stretches'.
quests.nativeTip: As a final check, find the true subject after the verb, ignoring the opening phrase about the valley.
quests.example: Across the valley stretches a chain of snow-capped mountains.
